verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's own docs support building and testing a full API integration in Test mode, and include a developer guide that explains in depth how to handle checkout and subscription events; embeddable checkout and checkout links lower the integration effort. Nothing in the evidence shows copy-paste code samples in multiple languages, official SDKs, or that an integration can be finished in under a day, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: copy-paste code examples per language, official SDKs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on evidence of time-to-integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language
